title: Faces the key misses go black: add a camera-side fill and a fake bounce
summary: Faces a grazing key misses and ceilings with no GI render black where references are mid-grey. Add a soft fill from the camera side and a cheap bounce (floor spot up, small emissive).

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.example: dig: DirectionalLight(0x8a90a0, .55) from (-2, 4, 20); tunnel: SpotLight(0xd8ccbc, 4) from the sunlit floor up to the ceiling + concCeil emissive 0x2a2724

doc.when: Any face the reference shows textured but your key leaves dark; any interior lit by a strong sun patch.
doc.avoid: Brightening the grade (lifts everything) or raising the hemisphere (flattens).
gotchas: Document emissive cheats in the code: they read as GI only at low values.

problem.symptom: Black cut faces, ceiling undersides, shadowed walls where the reference is mid-grey.
problem.cause: Direct lights only (no GI); the key barely reaches faces at grazing angles; dark albedo.
problem.fix: A soft fill from the camera side, a bounce light from the lit floor, a slightly brighter albedo, a small documented emissive.
problem.detect: Region means: the face's mean far below the reference's.
